[size=3]A small pack of new? mushroom trees to add more variety to your game, saw those in the Junimo Kart game, I really like their look so I made them into trees outside of the mini game, will do more colors later, enjoy! :D
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hNORhek.png[/img][/size][center][size=3]﻿ [url=https://www.stardewvalley.net/author/concernedape/]ConcernedApe[/url] for the Junimo Kart Game <3[/size][/center][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/n2YpLy5.png[/img]
[/size][center][size=3][b]1[/b]. Download this mod and Alternative Textures

[b]2[/b]. Drop everything in the mods folder

[b]3[/b]. Buy the paint bucket from Robin and use it on a mushroom tree 

[b]4[/b].  It's done!
